name: Nefur Apawrt
source:
"Nefur Apawrt" follows Sunny, a laidback dog, and Pumpkin, an anxious (transgender!!!) cat, as they go on a date! Follow one of two paths where they try to have a fun time while navigating personal issues.

[From [url=https://whisp-rabbit.itch.io/nefur-apawrt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Nefur Apawrt》讲述了一只悠闲的狗Sunny和一只焦虑的（变性！！！）猫Pumpkin去约会的故事！遵循两条路径之一，让他们在解决个人问题的同时享受乐趣。

[来自[url=https://whisp-rabbit.itch.io/nefur-apawrt]itch.io[/url]]
